english: It'll just be an empty lot.
Sougo!
He's lost the will to live!
Honestly, can't we just leave it?
What's wrong?
Get a grip!
...He's a terminal case.
He's hopeless...
Hey, your job?
Hey! What about Otae?!
Otae...? What's that? Actually... who are you again?
Is that good or bad...?
You're quitting! I heard you!
What a lazy criminal!
...Just a lazy old man.
Katoken too...?
Not a trace of the Katoken Samba.
You already are!
Then you're just some old guy...
What about your shop?
Hey! What are you saying?!
What?!
He's practically a walking corpse.
...No, even worse than that.
Don't try to stop me. I've already quit...\fI hate the sea... Actually, even hating it is too much work...
This one too...?
He's the biker gang's boss?
He's hopeless...
Well, the town's more peaceful with him taking a break...
What the hell's a yakuza holiday...?
That yakuza again.
Oh... the Shinsengumi...
What a godless shrine maiden...
Should a shrine maiden be this lazy?!
Hey, you two! Weren't you going to be great carpenters?!
These two as well?!
Brat... Watch your mouth...
This guy too...?
Shuwaaatch...
We can ignore this one.
You don't care...?
Forget managing. You're failing as a mother.
...I'm sorry.
...My apologies.
...Pardon my stench.
But... it's such a drag...
Where are you lot off to? So full of energy.
Closed today? Good. I was getting bored with this job anyway.
...No, that's even more work.
If you're going out, do this for me.
Hang this sign at the entrance. I can't be bothered to move.
I haven't sunk so low I'd attack a nerd in glasses.
Well, he was crazy to begin with.
Otose went out... Honestly... even talking is too much work...
What?! Someone attacked Shinpachi?!
What the hell happened?
What?! Getting ahead of us?! You traitor!
Tough luck!
Someone...? Who?
...No, I doubt the culprit's a thief.
A thief would target Shinpachi? He doesn't look remotely rich.
Everyone makes an enemy or two without even realizing it.
Right! In that case...
Kagura! Shinpachi, can you walk?
We can't let the bastard who hurt our dear Shinpachi get away!
Exactly. Then we take all his money... Hey! Wait!
Idiot, Kagura! You made me accidentally tell the truth!
Shinpachi, Kagura! You're half-trained, so pair up. Hmm... Check the north.
Quiet, Kagura. Let's go. See you later!
Come to think of it, I'm starving...
Hey! Hasegawa!
Hey, don't treat me like a mosquito larva!
Looking for someone with a grudge against me or Shinpachi... Not your problem, I guess.
You wouldn't have a grudge against us.
Come on. That joke still isn't funny.
You got fired too? You're such a klutz, Hasegawa.
Oh, come on. You make it sound like my fault.
Huh? Really? Seriously? Then...!
You don't hold a grudge against me...?!
Give it up. Even if it's you, I can't let Shinpachi's attacker go.
Tch. You're stubborn. Fine! I'll settle for 50,000 yen!
Let's settle this by force! A Gin Tama battle!
Hmm... If you're that adamant... then you didn't attack Shinpachi?
What a stupid waste of time... See you!
I can't believe it... I actually lost to you.
Justice? So you're saying you didn't attack Shinpachi?
Tch! Then this was a total waste of time! What a wasted trip!
If you're not the culprit, we're done. I'm off.
What?! Then... does that mean...?
How is that even allowed?!
Oh, it's Saigo Mama.
What a greeting. I'm busy here.
Are you trying to pick a fight? ...Oh... Wait a minute...
Shinpachi said one blow knocked him out.
So the culprit must have inhuman strength...?!
Hey, Mama... You didn't...
Attack Shinpachi from behind?
I know it's unlikely, but you might hold a grudge against us too...
N-no, I'm not saying you did it...
M-make amends...?!
Huh? Sure I've got some, but not out here...
Oh, THOSE balls...
Guess I'll have to defend myself.
Another pointless waste of time. I'd better hurry up and find the culprit...
Uh, yeah. Still no leads, though.
Really?! I'll go take a look! Thanks, Saigo Mama!
Crap, I lost.
...So what happens to me now?
No, I'm not into that...!
W-wait a minute... Don't tell me this is going where I think...!
We just met and you call me a bastard?
Where is WHAT?!
Weird gorilla. Looking for a wig? Try your head.
Never heard of anyone called Zura.
Forget that. Seen a nasty-looking samurai?
Someone attacked our Shinpachi.
Oh, you're technically the police, right?
Perfect. Find Shinpachi's attacker for me.
Unless... you're the ones who attacked Shinpachi?
That nasty-looking samurai Saigo Mama mentioned... Yep! This gorilla fits!
Trying to shut me up?! I won't let you!
You're on. Don't think you can beat a human.
Either way's fine. Come on, gorilla!
You're a million years too early to beat a human! Go evolve, then try again!
I don't have time to play with gorillas. I'm off.
What? I said I don't know where Zura is.
What are you planning?
I don't have time!
Wait a second! Right now, Shinpachi's...
...B-but isn't that...
Who are you talking to, gorilla?!
This is your fault, Shinpachi! You should've seen the culprit's face!
What?!
So... chasing Zura is connected to Gin Tama too?
Huh. You take your job more seriously than the gorilla.
...Well, let's go home. Go home and eat.
Huh? Something's outside the shop.
Huh? Saburo? Who the hell's that? What a boring name...
Whoa! You're right!
I've got a bad feeling. Sounds like more trouble...
I came all this way. Got anything for me?
Then what IS going on?! I'm so hungry I've gone past angry!
Lost something?
Oh... from back then... What are you looking for?
Who are these guys? Why Shinpachi...?
Something to tell me?
What's going on?
What about Gin Tama?
Shinpachi, nobody likes a know-it-all.
Obviously! Otherwise we couldn't even read it!
You mean THOSE Gin Tama...
Check that BEFORE making them!
If you regret it, don't charge us money on top of it!
Bangbangji?
translator_note: Misheard Banbanji as the chicken dish.

english: Where'd that come from?
Why me?! Get the Shinsengumi to do it!
What, Shinpachi?
...Tch. Guess I've got no choice.
I don't want to... I really don't... But...
This is why I didn't want to come here!
Well, Gin Tama and those... what was it? Chimpanzees?
Right, that too. But how are we supposed to investigate them?
Kagura, stop! You'll get killed!
Picking a fight with a killer? They've got a death wish...
They're gone. Nothing we can do. Maybe next time... Let's get going too.
Shut up, you AAAA alien! What is it?!
Oh, right. You collect Gin Tama too, don't you?
Apparently, those things might be dangerous. So give them to me.
Come on! Hand them over!
You've changed your tune since before.
A doll?
Maybe something huge is going on without us knowing.
By force?!
Fine! If I win, I get the Gin Tama!
You promised! All your Gin Tama!
Well, we've collected some more Gin Tama...
So we'll have to catch him and ask him ourselves.
An old pest I can't shake off.
Shinpachi! Whose side are you on?!
You bastard...
Did I promise that?
Your side...? Shinpachi! Whose side are you on?!
What is this aimless mess? We're getting nowhere!
Then what do we do?!
Quit trying to look cool, Zura!
Whatever. I've got questions for you.
Damn right. Today, you're telling me everything.
I didn't mean to. It just... happened?
You're right. Only Catherine's here.
Who's this guy?
Hey, where's the old hag?
W-what the hell is this?!
Yeah... Let's do that...
I can't believe it... Even Saigo Mama's like this...
Don't tell me Hasegawa's gone weird too?
Let's ask him ourselves... Hey! Hasegawa!
What are you doing here?
Too much work...? Don't tell me you're too lazy to piss?!
Too lazy to piss?! You practically need a carer!
W-what happened, Hasegawa?! Are you back to normal?!
